topography.project_purpose: Equilibria is a yield optimization protocol built on top of Pendle Finance, focused on ePENDLE/Pendle-related boosted yield strategies. Broader LRT, governance, bribe, and cross-chain veTokenomics claims should be treated as contract-surface observations unless supported by current public documentation.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Equilibria Core on Ethereum issues EQB and vlEQB, which are bridged to sidechain deployments via XEqbToken and EPendleOFT tokens. Sidechain deployments replicate the booster/proxy/vault pattern and use shared infrastructure like BaseRewardPool and EqbZap, while the LRT family operates independently with its own set of oracles and deposit/withdrawal contracts.
